dedupeText: vintage romantic crooner album cover 1960s mid century modern typography portrait photography tight crop warm tones sans serif tight facial crop creates immediate emotional intimacy typography acts as a structural header anchoring the top right quadrant warm low key lighting emphasizes skin texture and hair detail the secondary figure provides a compositional frame for the main subject intimate portrait top right heavy grotesque typography warm film grain

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, intimate portrait of a male singer smiling, partially embraced by a partner whose back is to the camera, featuring heavy top-aligned sans-serif typography that bleeds toward the upper right corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Tight facial crop creates immediate emotional intimacy
Typography acts as a structural header, anchoring the top-right quadrant
Warm, low-key lighting emphasizes skin texture and hair detail
The secondary figure provides a compositional frame for the main subject
coreInvariants: Tight letter-spacing in the display type

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Main subject is centrally located, filling approximately 70% of the frame vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and smile form the central focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the large header text at the top right, down to the subject's face, then to the embracing figure on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with the subject and the secondary figure.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high contrast in the facial features; overall warm temperature.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid cool blues except for clothing

characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital letters and lowercase are set with minimal leading
The 'y' and 'V' in the name are tightly nested
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used in varying scales for title and tracklist.
graphicDevices: Thin horizontal rule separating metadata at bottom

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the mid-century grotesque aesthetic and weight.
Provides the necessary density and tight counters.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a warm-toned 1960s style portrait of a smiling man with curly hair, in a tight embrace with a woman whose back is turned. Use low-key lighting and film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold sans-serif text in the top right corner, flush right, with extremely tight letter spacing and off-white color.

verificationChecks: Is the kerning tight enough that letters almost touch?
Is the color palette warm and nostalgic?
Is the crop tight on the subject's face?

adjustableVariables: Specific weight of the sans-serif font
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no modern artifacts are visible in the background
Check that typography does not obscure the subject's eyes
Verify the 'off-white' tone of the text matches the highlight tones in the photo
recipe.reuseFormula: Intimate Portrait + Top-Right Heavy Grotesque Typography + Warm Film Grain
